Sensing, signalling, and ABA‐dependent and non‐dependent transcriptional regulatory networks for drought stress in plants

Sensing, signalling, and ABA‐dependent and non‐dependent transcriptional regulatory networks for drought stress in plants. Drought response pathways are referenced in reported reviews (Liu et al., 2023). (a) Epigenetic modification annotation of factors related to drought stress sensing and signalling in plants. The number of TFs is all the TFs differentially expressed throughout the drought, not just the TFs regulated by SnRKs. (b, c) ABA‐dependent and ABA‐independent regulatory networks annotated by epigenetic modifications. Star shapes represent histone acetylation modified DEGs, squares represent histone methylation modified DEGs, and triangles represent DNA methylation modified DEGs. Different colours represent different modification types
